verdict.rationale: Granola Chat runs inside the product and lets users ask questions about their meetings and get insights. It works on one meeting, a folder, or all meetings, and can spot patterns across calls. Recipes, pre-meeting briefs and auto-drafted follow-up emails add proactive suggestions. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of Chat's cross-meeting insight quality; one community user also reports AI-extracted action items slipping through.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Granola Chat lets you ask questions about your meetings and get instant insights from your notes or transcripts.
Chat with your meeting notes to recall meeting details, spot patterns across customer calls, and generate follow-up outputs.
You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
Recipes are reusable prompt templates that help you quickly get insights from your meeting notes without typing the same questions repeatedly.
Open your note as you join and you'll see a short brief with open threads, relevant context, and agenda points so you walk in ready.
After an external meeting, Granola can automatically draft a follow-up email - using context from your transcript, calendar, and past Gmail threads - so you can send it in a couple of clicks.
